itemized.page_subtotal_gates: This filing is NOT the blank-grid form - it is a machine-printed slco.org disclosure summary (footer 'http://slcintranet/financialDisclosure/clerk/summary_printer.cfm?ID=652'), and its tables print NO per-page subtotal at all, only one Total per schedule at the end of the table. Contribution rows across pages 1-2 sum 24,580.00 = the printed Total Contributions 24,580.00; expenditure rows on page 2 sum 30,459.54 = the printed Total Expenditures 30,459.54. Both gate EXACT. Two pages carry a page-subtotal-free layout by design, so 'no page would not gate' applies here in the sense that there is nothing to gate against beyond the totals.
itemized.notes: ONLY 2 PAGES, and the usual layout does not apply: this is a WEB-PRINTED Salt Lake County Clerk disclosure summary, not the hand-filled form. Page 1 carries the cover block, the Summary table AND the first five Schedule A rows; page 2 carries the remaining seven Schedule A rows plus all of Schedule B. The candidate's own address, phone, fax and email on the cover are county-redacted with black bars, but this web-printed Schedule A has NO address column at all (its columns are Date Received / Contributor Name / Occupation / Employer / Type / Amount / In-Kind?), so donor_city and donor_state do not exist on the source and are blank by non-existence, not by redaction. The Summary table's Column B (YTD) cells are hand-written over the printed form ($49,580 / $32,391.47) and lines 3, 5 and 7 are hand-written too - that is the cover/Summary layer already transcribed upstream and is not redone here. THREE Schedule A rows are AGGREGATE lines ('Aggregate Contributions Under $50') rather than named donors and are transcribed verbatim as such. FOUR Schedule A rows are contributions from the candidate MARK CROCKETT himself totalling 18,150.00 of the 24,580.00 raised, and the Schedule B side pays 'O'Hara & Associates' 27,150.00 in six 'Reimbursement-Campaign Expenses/Personnel' rows - recorded, not interpreted. One donor's Occupation and Employer both print the filer's placeholder 'Requested'. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: machine-set table with ruled cells; 12 dates / 12 names / 12 amounts on the A side and 17/17/17 on the B side, all typed and in-column; both sides gate exactly on their printed Totals. No shift found.
